entries.title: II Chronicles 1:1
segments: When the Lord is with his people they will be strong, and by his word, Spirit, and providence be furnished for every good work.

entries.title: II Chronicles 1:3
segments: There was the tabernacle; the tabernacle and brazen altar of burnt-offering made under the direction of Moses in the wilderness remained at Gibeon, though the ark had been carried to Jerusalem.  See notes to

entries.title: II Chronicles 1:6
segments: Communion with God and supreme devotion to him, are a good preparation for the reception of all needed blessings.

entries.title: II Chronicles 1:10
segments: Go out and come in; discharge aright his public duties.

entries.title: II Chronicles 1:11
segments: When men desire that wisdom which is from above more than they desire wealth, power, or influence, they may expect to receive it; and with it all things necessary for their spiritual and everlasting good.

entries.title: II Chronicles 1:16
segments: Linen yarn; or, as some render, caravans or companies of horses.
